title: UK single release: With A Little Luck by Wings | 1978
content:
Wings’ single ‘With A Little Luck’ was released in the United Kingdom on 24 March 1978.

It came out one week before the London Town album. The b-sides were ‘Backwards Traveller’ and ‘Cuff Link’.

‘With A Little Luck’ entered the UK top 100 on 1 April at number 42, and peaked at number five on 22 April. It spent a total of nine weeks on the chart.

It fared better in America, following its 17 March release. ‘With A Little Luck’ spent two weeks at the top of the Billboard Hot 100 from 20 May.
